products.label: JPL Horizons, satellite ephemerides SAT455 to SAT459
products.process: Take every confirmed Saturn moon in the pinned JPL catalogue that has no object package and has a Horizons code; ask Horizons for its geometric position relative to Saturn's centre at the world's epoch; draw one dot at that position.
limitations: No colour is measured for these moons; every dot is the neutral grey the app gives a moon without a measured colour, and its size is a display choice.
S/2009 S1 and S/2009 S2 have no Horizons ephemeris and are not drawn.
